body: Founder, real-time: 'redgarden services need okemily status page.' Added the three live REDGARDEN systemd --user units (redgarden-matchmaker-bots :7778 10v10, redgarden-matchmaker-players :7779 1v1, redgarden-bot-pool persistent 19-bot pool) as CheckSystemdUnit targets in internal/statuspage/checker.go's DefaultTargets(), same convention already used for shankpit460-emily-bot.service. status.html itself needed no changes since it's fully data-driven off GET /api/v1/status. Rebuilt + restarted the live iduna.service, verified all three report up:true within one poll cycle, visible at okemily.com/status.html. Commit e7f8a44.
title: REDGARDEN services added to okemily.com status page
